about: A self-hosted accounting app that reads receipts and invoices.

prs.title: Imported CSV amounts are no longer a cent short
prs.broken: Importing amounts from a CSV file saved many of them one cent low, so 4.35 was stored as 4.34, because of a rounding slip.
prs.changed: I made the import round to the nearest cent, as the entry form already did.
prs.matters: Imported books add up to the same totals as the bank statement.
